0022600023.text: The Los Angeles Lakers, who are 4-1 and first in the Pacific and fourth in the West, come into their sixth game of the season on a one-game winning streak, while the Golden State Warriors are 2-3, 10th in the West, and riding a two-game winning streak. Lakers unavailable are Adou Thiero (knee inflammation, out) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain, out), and Ziaire Williams is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision; Warriors unavailable are Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery, out), Kristaps Porzingis (illness, out), and Moses Moody (knee surgery, out), and Gui Santos is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and a game-time decision. The Lakers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 127-105 win in Los Angeles on October 21, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
